status.description: DELIVERED for a real offer that was charged. Anything else names why the row is not an offer and is free: NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY, NOT_CHECKED_NO_MATCH, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, INVALID_INPUT.

board.description: The Recruitee board slug the row came from.

jobId.description: Recruitee offer id. One offer is one row, even when it lists several offices.

title.description: Offer title as the employer wrote it.

location.description: The office line as the employer wrote it, for example Vienna, Wien, Austria.

state.description: State or region of the first office.

countryCode.description: Two letter country code of the first office.

locations.description: Every office of this offer, not only the first one. 27% of live offers carry more than one and each of them stays one row.

remote.description: True when the offer itself is marked remote.

hybrid.description: True when the offer itself is marked hybrid.

onSite.description: True when the offer itself is marked on site.

employmentType.description: Employment type code, for example fulltime_permanent.

experience.description: Experience level code, for example mid_level.

education.description: Education level code when the employer set one.

category.description: Offer category code, for example banking.

salaryMin.description: Lower salary bound as a number, null when the employer left it empty. 1,299 and 1.299,00 both arrive as numbers, not as 1.299.

salaryMax.description: Upper salary bound as a number, null when empty.

salaryCurrency.description: Currency of the salary, when the employer set one.

salaryPeriod.description: Salary period, when the employer set one.

tags.description: Tags the employer attached to the offer.

publishedAt.description: Publish time as the feed reports it, for example 2026-10-30 16:32:58 UTC.

applyUrl.description: Public application form for this offer.

description.description: Full offer description, HTML by default, plain text with descriptionFormat=text. Null when includeDetails is off.

requirements.description: Requirements section, HTML by default. Null when includeDetails is off.

reason.description: Why this row is not a delivered offer.

delivered.description: True only for a row that was written as a real offer.

billable.description: What the price list said before the row was written: true when it carries this event, false when billing is off, null when the price could not be read. The money actually taken is chargedEvents in the run summary.
